name: magentic-stack
description: Runs the CPCP seams. One Rails image under many ROLEs, plus MIND (Python), SwitchYard (Rust upstream behind a Node front) and oxigraph.

contract.note: Scope vocabulary and the method-to-scope map come from spec/scopes.md at this revision. Adding a scope to a seam is a contract change there first. Referenced by repo and revision, not by path: ADR 0020 keeps gems/adapters/ the only code that reaches the vendored tree, and the pin records live in the manifests.

registry.note: Full SHA, never an abbreviation: an abbreviated rev is not a durable reference and stops being unique as the repo grows. Kept equal to the pin record for this submodule and to the gitlink, so the registry a reader resolves is the one the tree carries.

scopes.note: One manifest per scope this repo stands in. A seam appears in every scope manifest it is reachable at -- one seam under two exposure rules, never two seams. No dependency or pod_internal_dependencies manifest: every seam this repo's containers call is one it serves itself, listed under pod_internal_services, and it calls no CID served by anybody else.

unscoped_seams.because: UNDECLARED. This seam is live here but does not appear in the contract method-to-scope map. It is browser-local credential routing (switchyard.route, cpcp.ready, cid), not pod-network traffic, so none of the three scopes is obviously right. Needs a contract decision, not a guess here.

not_a_seam.front: route-gated off /_cpcp (ADR 0047 amendment 2). Publishes a page, admits nothing.
not_a_seam.runtimes/switch: OpenAI-compatible completions, no /_cpcp. Node today, target Rust.
not_a_seam.shape: GET-only retrieval, not a POST-rpc seam.
